description_html:
Key Features

  • Graupel-Chilled Infusion Technology: Utilizes an advanced graupel-chilling method to deliver a precise and consistent brew temperature of 66°C, ensuring optimal flavor extraction for every infusion.
  • Durable Construction: The carafe has a robust body mass of 2503 grams, providing stability and long-lasting durability for daily use.
  • Single Batch Capacity: Designed for single servings, the carafe holds up to 162 millilitres per batch—ideal for personal use or sampling specialty infusions.
  • Accurate Extraction Timing: Features a controlled extraction time of 466 seconds, allowing for a balanced and full-bodied beverage with every brew.
  • Passive Heat Storage: Operates with a passive heat store system, requiring no external power source and maintaining the ideal temperature throughout the brewing process.
  • Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, offering adaptable purchasing options for different buyers.

Main Benefits

  • Consistent Flavor Quality: The precise temperature control and extraction timing help users achieve a perfect brew, maximizing taste and aroma.
  • Energy-Efficient Operation: With its passive heat storage, the carafe is eco-friendly and cost-effective, suitable for users seeking sustainable brewing solutions.
  • Reliability & Stability: The substantial weight and sturdy design ensure the carafe remains secure during use, addressing concerns about tipping or breakage.
  • Personalized Brewing: The single batch size makes it easy to prepare fresh, custom infusions without waste, catering to users who value freshness and portion control.

Typical Use Cases & Outcomes

  • Home and Office Brewing: Ideal for individuals looking to prepare high-quality tea, coffee, or herbal infusions at home or work without the need for electric brewing devices.
  • Specialty Beverage Preparation: Suited for enthusiasts who want to experiment with precise brewing parameters to achieve unique flavor profiles.
  • Eco-Conscious Consumers: Appeals to users searching for energy-saving, low-maintenance brewing solutions that do not require electricity.
  • Gift or Specialty Item: Makes a thoughtful gift for tea or coffee lovers who appreciate innovative brewing equipment and enjoy single-serve convenience.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is it easy to use? Yes, the carafe’s passive heat system and clear brewing parameters make it simple for anyone to achieve consistent results.
  • Is it durable? The heavy-duty construction ensures long-term reliability and resistance to daily wear.
  • Does it require electricity? No, the passive heat storage system eliminates the need for external power, offering flexibility and portability.
  • What is the capacity? The carafe is designed for single servings, holding 162 ml per batch—perfect for personal use or tasting sessions.

This graupel-chilled infusion carafe combines precision brewing, energy efficiency, and robust design, making it an excellent choice for users seeking a reliable, eco-friendly, and easy-to-use single-serve brewing solution.
